analysis.title: Nomura - McElligott - WHEWWWWW - 17 Nov 2026
key_insights: Equities have moved to a higher realized vol and wider straddle regime. McElligott says the VIX floor and vol of vol have reset higher on demand for the wings, skew steepening and an unusual jump in correlation, which left dealers short gamma against spot during the multi-day drawdown.

He sees no large vol shorts or VIX gamma positioning among dealers that would accelerate a vol shock above VIX 30, unless spot indices fall much further in a repeat of December 2018. Front VIX futures at 20-22, VIX in the low 20s and VVIX at 110-120 look appropriate to him.

Four catalysts this week could set direction: NVDA earnings Tuesday night, VIX expiration Wednesday, the Anthropic IPO pricing Wednesday with trading Thursday, and monthly options expiration Friday. A large share of SPX downside hedges that dealers are short to customers expire in December, so vanna sensitivity to a vol reset should persist even as options expire.

He describes two-way accelerant risk and a wider straddle environment. In a month the S&P 500 is either through 6500 or at 7800 heading to 8000. A vol cool-down to VIX 17-18 could force mechanical equity buying that hurts investors constrained by VaR, a 'buyers are higher' pain trade.
USD rates saw two-way vol last week, with daily straddles breached in both directions at times. The main change was a reset in skew, with high vol on selloffs and higher yields.

He attributes the weaker macro tone to financial conditions tightening: higher real rates, wider credit spreads, wealth-effect risk from equity declines, a hawkish central bank repricing under Chair Warsh with nearly 2 hikes added for spring 2027, and a global supply shock from the Iran conflict with no exit.

Stocks are now the largest contributor to US household wealth at $74 trillion, 48% of household net assets, ahead of real estate. Households gained nearly $10 trillion from stocks in 2Q26. This makes equities the main channel from financial conditions to the economy.

Other pressures cited are heavy debt and equity supply from AI capex financing and G10 fiscal deficits, and converging AI and geopolitical headlines about outages, hacks and infrastructure vulnerability.

NVDA is down 35% over the past month and a half. He points to a reset in the view of NVDA as the 'central bank of AI', the loss of Jensen Huang, a temporary CEO and a CFO-led downshift in risk appetite, customers sensing pricing leverage, and industry revenue expectations for China cut to zero.

He doubts NVDA can 'kitchen sink' the quarter to lower the bar for new management, since the numbers, guidance and language were already set and the company must keep its bullish story intact. He expects the call Q&A to focus on circular financing and the impact of sales bans on China-linked buyers in Asia.
Options desk flow showed bullish call-spread buying in megacap tech on the dip, in AMZN, GOOGL, INTC and MU.

At a macro dinner, consensus was for higher equities and higher Treasury yields at year-end and one year out, with only one view for lower stocks and one for lower rates. Crude was similar, with only one person seeing it lower.

Attendees agreed financial conditions tightening is accelerating but expected passive flows and moral hazard (a belief that authorities will step in) to keep driving buy-the-dip behavior in passive, target-date and 401k money.

Positioning is washed out among professionals: net leverage at zero to low single digits per prime brokers, systematic equity exposure at the 10th percentile after $116B of selling in two weeks, Mag7 call skew at the 12th percentile and SPX call skew at the 22nd. This sets up a 'buyers are higher' dynamic in rallies.
Last week's EPFR flows were around the 100th percentile for one-week inflows to stocks since 2000. Asset manager length in ES1 per CFTC data points to strong forward returns, per the note.
Buybacks continue in the largest names. AAPL has repurchased $840B over a decade, has about $210 in active authorization across 3 programs and is up 30% YTD.
The risk to buy-the-dip conditioning is averaging down into a bounce that does not come, which becomes a 'sellers are lower' risk, amplified by mechanical flows on gaps.
Late in the session a vol seller sold 13k SPX Nov 7500 puts at 203 (88 days), about $1B of gamma, which gave dealers some gamma back. SPX rallied about 50 points off the lows.
earnings_insights: NVDA reports Tuesday night 11/17. McElligott expects the quarter's numbers, guidance and language to be already set, with the call focused on long-horizon issues (circular financing, China sales bans) rather than the quarter itself.

macro_indicators.interpretation: Stocks are now the largest single contributor to US household wealth, ahead of real estate, so equity drawdowns tighten financial conditions through the wealth effect.
A large positive wealth effect from stocks, which reverses if equities fall.
Cited as the labor backdrop for passive buy-the-dip flows into equities.
Hawkish repricing against Chair Warsh adds to financial conditions tightening.

risk_factors: A repeat of December 2018 style crash in spot indices could trigger a vol shock above VIX 30.
Financial conditions tightening from higher real rates, wider credit spreads and hawkish central bank repricing.
Negative wealth effect from a larger equity pullback, since stocks are now 48% of household net assets.
NVDA earnings and call Q&A on circular financing and China sales bans.
Debt and equity supply from AI capex financing and G10 fiscal deficits.
Iran supply shock with no offramp and the risk of added hike expectations.
Buy-the-dip conditioning leading to averaging down into declines, with mechanical flows on gaps accelerating overshoots.
AI-related and geopolitical headlines on outages, hacks and infrastructure vulnerability.
vol_and_positioning: Equities are in a higher realized vol, wider straddle regime. VIX floor and VVIX have moved up, skew has steepened sharply and correlation has risen unusually.
Dealers are short gamma against spot. Little dealer short vol or VIX gamma positioning exists to push VIX above 30 without a further spot crash.
Front VIX futures at 20-22, VIX in the low 20s, VVIX 110-120. A move back to VIX 17-18 could trigger mechanical equity buying.
A large share of SPX downside hedges that dealers are short are for December expiration, which keeps vanna sensitivity after this week's expiries.
USD rates vol: skew reset, with high vol into selloffs and higher yields.
Positioning: net leverage at zero to low single digits per prime brokers, systematic equity exposure at the 10th percentile, Mag7 call skew at the 12th percentile, SPX call skew at the 22nd.

Flow: buyer of 15.5k AMZN Feb 295/350 call spreads at $7.45, 3k GOOGL Nov 307.5/316 call spreads at $0.25, 20k INTC Sep 95 calls at $4.49 and 8.8k MU Feb 920/1000 call spreads at $14.24. A vol seller sold 13k SPX Nov 7500 puts at 203.
geopolitical: Iran conflict described as a global supply shock with no offramp, including refinery capacity limits, VLCC shortages and low downstream product inventories.
Sales bans affecting China-linked buyers throughout Asia, hitting AI supply-chain revenue expectations.
Asian authorities banning shorts or setting up state-backed stock support funds, cited as examples of moral hazard.

tension_points.theme: equity dip buying vs tightening conditions
tension_points.bull_case: Passive flows, buybacks, record one-week fund inflows, washed-out professional positioning and expected authority backstops keep 'buy the dip' going and create a 'buyers are higher' dynamic if vol cools to VIX 17-18.
tension_points.bear_case: Financial conditions are tightening through higher real rates, wider credit spreads and hawkish repricing, dealers are short gamma, and buy-the-dip investors averaging down create 'sellers are lower' risk with NVDA, AI and geopolitical headlines stacking.
tension_points.what_invalidates: SPX falling through 6500 or a Dec 2018 style spot crash would break the dip-buying thesis and could send VIX above 30.

theme_stances.key_argument: Equities have moved to a higher realized vol, wider straddle regime with dealers short gamma and two-way accelerant risk.
NVDA's role as the perceived put across the AI ecosystem has weakened after leadership changes and China revenue cuts.
